text: Arcadia Fence & Gate is a licensed fence and gate contractor based in the Phoenix Metro Area, Arizona. The company is owned by Joe Pagano and serves Phoenix Metro, East Mesa, and surrounding Arizona communities.
Arcadia Fence & Gate website is arcadiafenceaz.com. The company has a verified Google Business listing and an active Facebook page with 71 followers.

Arcadia Fence & Gate offers the following services: Chain Link fencing (galvanized and coated), Ornamental Iron, Composite fencing, Block walls (CMU), Vinyl fencing, and Custom Gates (pedestrian and vehicular).
Arcadia Fence & Gate sources materials from Merchant Metals in Phoenix, AZ. Recent projects include 5ft galvanized chain link installations at Arizona Skies Senior Community in East Mesa.

Owner Joe Pagano actively manages the business and posts project updates on social media. The company operates in the Phoenix Metro Area and specializes in residential and commercial fencing throughout Arizona.
